description: Update an existing opportunity — edit its RICE inputs, stage, theme assignment, program link, or other fields. At least one field must be provided. Requires `write` scope.

archived.description: Set true to soft-archive this opportunity; false to restore it.

description.description: Updated description of what the opportunity is and why it matters.

evidence.description: Free-text evidence backing the opportunity. Persisted; an empty string clears it.

id.description: ID of the opportunity to update.

programId.description: Delivery program to link this opportunity to, without promoting it (find ids via anyforge_list_programs). Pass null to unlink. Promotion (anyforge_promote_opportunity) still sets this automatically.

rice.description: RICE prioritisation inputs. All four numbers and a rationale are required when provided; each number snaps to the nearest RICE bucket.

confidence.description: Confidence in the estimates, 0–1 (1 = fully confident). Values above 1 are clamped to 1.

impact.description: How much it moves the needle (0.25 | 0.5 | 1 | 2 | 3).

operatorLoad.description: Operator review/HIL attention to ship this — the cost axis (NOT engineering effort). Higher = more operator supervision.

rationale.description: Why these scores; backs all four factors. Required.

reach.description: How many users are affected per period.

stage.description: Opportunity stage. Allowed: IDEA | VALIDATED | READY_TO_PLAN | PLANNED | SHIPPED | MEASURING | ARCHIVED.

themeId.description: Theme ID to assign this opportunity to.

timeCriticality.description: Time criticality score (≥ 0). Higher values indicate more time-sensitive opportunities.

title.description: New short name for the opportunity.

name: anyforge_update_opportunity
title: Update opportunity
